speech.heard: Central African Republic has 16% young boys, in Japan it is 4%. Central African Republic is the world's highest, almost 1 in 6 males there is a child. It has 2.8 times the share of the USA, which has 5.8%. This counts the male population between the ages 5 to 9, as a percentage of all males. India has 8.1%. The lowest shares on Earth, Japan and Italy at 4% and South Korea at 3.5%. Somalia has 15.7%, and Dr. Congo has 15.4%. Do you see many young boys in your city?
